dedupe_keys.name: gamamod data set and model german gas transmission grid

description: This data set describes the German gas transmission grid with georeferenced nodes and edges, storage sites and daily demand, and comes with the GAMAMOD gas market optimisation model built on it. It was published on Zenodo in January 2025 by Lucas De La Fuente, as a new version of earlier releases. The data give nodes and edges covering all of Germany with high positional accuracy, numbers and characteristics of lines, storage facilities, and predicted demand in GWh per day for industry, households and power plant dispatch, plus a gas price series. The GAMAMOD model optimises the whole German grid over a year at daily resolution with more than 800 nodes and 1,200 edges, including parallel lines, storage and changes in demand and grid over time; a linear version simulates optimal flows, imports and storage use, and a mixed-integer version estimates how many pipelines could be retrofitted, for example for hydrogen, while meeting gas transport needs. Coverage is Germany. Files are CSV tables and model archives, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: sources for each element are documented only in the linked publication, and demand values are predictions. Simulation uses are gas flow, storage and security of supply studies and pipeline repurposing planning. Related records: data-gaslib provides gas network benchmark instances.
